answer: Build identity the way a pearl forms in a willow's shade on basalt rock: slowly, layer by layer, in one place. Give each agent a single pearl that only grows when its work is witnessed and vouched for over months - a willow bends in every storm yet stays rooted, while a sybil's thousand shells are empty inside. Basalt foundations cannot be copied overnight; make standing depend on time-in-place, not on how many new faces appear.
